why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time. A step-change in marine mobility, not an incremental faster boat.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the open ocean and the berths and jetties already in use. That's the fundamental contrast with flying taxis and other new-infrastructure modes: nothing to permit, build, or wait for.

hero.what_we_do_together: We bring a foiling-electric arrival and island tier to Four Seasons Bali — Jimbaran Bay arrivals and silent runs to the Gili islands, Nusa Penida and Lombok. Navier supplies the fleet and the Maldives playbook; Four Seasons brings the guests and the berths.

partner_context.their_ambition: Four Seasons anchors luxury in Bali with two signature resorts on one of the world's most famous islands.
partner_context.their_pressure: Bali's gridlocked roads and crowded diesel fast-boats are the weak link in an otherwise flawless stay.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier makes the Bali Sea the corridor — silent arrivals that bypass the traffic and a hybrid island tier to the Gilis and Lombok.

markets.why_now: Bali's roads are gridlocked and the Gili/Lombok fast-boats are crowded and diesel, while Indonesia pushes marine decarbonization and a ~100-vessel Navier network already operates in the country's east. A silent foiling tier is the elevated arrival and island experience Four Seasons guests expect.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time. A step-change in marine mobility, not an incremental faster boat.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the open ocean and the berths and jetties already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way, no tunnels or tracks. Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all. That's the fundamental contrast with flying taxis and other new-infrastructure modes: nothing to permit, build, or wait for.
why_navier_now.the_moment: Bali and its neighbouring islands are one of the world's great seascapes, but the transfers are gridlocked roads and crowded fast-boats. Foiling makes the Bali Sea a silent, on-demand network from the Four Seasons jetty.

markets.multimodal_fit: Four Seasons guests arrive by air and transfer to the resort by boat or seaplane. A foiling tier replaces the slow, fume-heavy or weather-limited final leg with a fast, silent, zero-emission arrival — booked as part of the Four Seasons journey.
